sponsored.t: Relates to the residency of certain officers of the village of Washingtonville, Orange county
sponsored.sum: Expands the residency requirement for the village clerk, deputy village clerk, village treasurer, and deputy village treasurer of the village of Washingtonville such that such person need not be a resident of such village, but must be a resident in the county in which such village is located or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Makes major revisions to provisions of the alcoholic beverage control law relating to the issuance of licenses and hours of operation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to the powers of the chairman and members of the state liquor authority (Part A); authorizes special permits to remain open during certain hours of the morning (Part B); relates to permissible sales by license holders (Part C); allows multiple off-premises licenses (Part D); relates to licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages and retail licensees (Part E); relates to the approval of seven day licenses to sell liquor at retail for consumption off the premises (Part F); relates to changes of ownership of a licensed business (Part G); relates to the issuance of temporary retail permits; makes…

sponsored.t: Relates to the wastewater infrastructure and drinking water program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes a wastewater infrastructure and drinking water program for the purpose of making payments toward the replacement and rehabilitation of existing local municipally-owned and funded drinking water, storm water and sanitary sewer systems; makes an appropriation therefor of $5,000,000.

sponsored.t: Permits the town of Monroe to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Monroe to impose a hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax at a rate of five percent.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Woodbury
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Woodbury to establish a demonstration program and install and operate traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices; relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Woodbury.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Palm Tree
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Palm Tree to establish a demonstration program and install and operate traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices; relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Palm Tree.

sponsored.t: Permits the sale of tonic water, bitters, and maraschino cherries at liquor stores
sponsored.sum: Permits the sale of tonic water, bitters, and maraschino cherries at liquor stores.

sponsored.t: Allows licensees to sell wine or liquor at retail to certain other licensees for resale for consumption off the premises
sponsored.sum: Allows licensees to sell wine or liquor at retail for consumption off the premises to certain other licensees; allows such other licensees to resell such wine or liquor for consumption off the premises.

sponsored.t: Relates to the adoption of a good cause for disapproval standard for certain off-premises retail licenses
sponsored.sum: Relates to the adoption of a good cause for disapproval standard for certain off-premises retail licenses by the liquor authority.

sponsored.t: Provides for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Provides for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises at 22 N Main Street in the village of Florida, county of Orange.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 2 of chapter 316 of the laws of 2025 relating to the use of tax funds collected by the county of Orange
sponsored.sum: Repeals certain provisions of law relating to the use of tax funds collected by the county of Orange, which permits Orange county to distribute all of its sales and compensating use taxes to the municipalities thereof.

sponsored.t: Authorizes licensees to remain open for extended hours of operation statewide for a specific period of time
sponsored.sum: Authorizes licensees to remain open for extended hours of operation statewide between June 11 and July 20, 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to the description of the arms of the state and the state flag
sponsored.sum: Removes the phrase E pluribus unum from the arms of the state and the state flag.

sponsored.t: Establishes a right of first refusal in the state for federal public land to be transferred
sponsored.sum: Establishes a right of first refusal in the state for federal public land to be transferred to private parties; prohibits the recording of any deeds for lands that have been transferred out of federal ownership to private ownership without giving the state the right of first refusal.

sponsored.t: Makes permanent certain provisions relating to liquidator's permits and temporary retail permits
sponsored.sum: Makes permanent certain provisions relating to liquidator's permits and temporary retail permits.

sponsored.t: Expands use of videoconferencing to purely advisory bodies
sponsored.sum: Expands use of videoconferencing to purely advisory bodies.
sponsored.fis: Enactment of this bill will reduce meeting costs for public bodies.

sponsored.t: Removes the requirement of the state liquor authority to have not more than two members of the authority belong to the same political party
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement of the state liquor authority to have not more than two members of the authority belong to the same political party.

sponsored.t: Permits employees of authorized organizations to operate games of chance
sponsored.sum: Permits employees of authorized organizations to operate games of chance.

sponsored.t: Relates to excluding taxes from the amount on which credit card transaction fees are based
sponsored.sum: Excludes the amount of state and local taxes and fees from the amount on which an interchange fee is charged for that electronic payment transaction by a credit or debit card network; prohibits a payment card network from altering or manipulating the computation and imposition of interchange fees.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to establish discharge plans and reentry services for wrongfully convicted individuals upon their discharge
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to establish discharge plans and reentry services for wrongfully convicted individuals upon their discharge which includes housing needs, educational needs, employment needs, medical needs, and specific social service needs.

sponsored.t: Requires elections and terms of certain officials occur on even-numbered years except in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires certain elections take place in even-numbered years for certain municipal and judicial officials except in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to payments by a pharmacy benefit manager to participating pharmacies
sponsored.sum: Requires a pharmacy benefit manager to pay a participating pharmacy at minimum at the national average drug acquisition cost (NADAC) rate, or at the pharmacy acquisition cost rate if greater or there is not a NADAC rate, plus a professional dispensing fee that is at minimum the professional dispensing fee paid under the state medical assistance program.

sponsored.t: Establishes "Kyra's Law"
sponsored.sum: Requires the court to consider a child's health and safety when making a decision regarding child custody and visitation; directs the court to review certain information as it relates to allegations of child abuse, domestic violence and child safety.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions relating to alcoholic beverages
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises and from selling at retail for consumption on the premises.

sponsored.t: Requires that tax amounts extended on the final assessment roll, and any interest or penalties subsequently accruing thereon, be rounded to the nearest five-cent denomination
sponsored.sum: Requires that tax amounts extended on the final assessment roll, and any interest or penalties subsequently accruing thereon, be rounded to the nearest five-cent denomination prior to inclusion on any bill or notice.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain powers of the attorney general
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the denial of access to certain public records which relate to civil investigations; relates to the enforcement powers of the attorney general; authorizes the attorney general to investigate and bring any civil action addressing repeated or persistent discrimination in elementary and secondary schools; requires the compromise of any claim which the state may have for care, maintenance or treatment furnished in hospitals or other such facilities to be made accordance with parameters established by the office of the attorney general; allows the commissioner of health to waive bills or compromise bills for the maintenance, care and treatment furnished to patients in medical…

sponsored.t: Relates to preventing certain elected officials from being a member of an agency or industrial development authority; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prevents certain elected officials from being a member of an agency or industrial development authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to the compulsory age for full time instruction from six to five years of age and certain exceptions for minor children
sponsored.sum: Relates to the compulsory age for full time instruction from six to five years of age and certain exceptions for minor children; requires kindergarten in certain school districts.

sponsored.t: Requires railroad corporations to inform the division of homeland security and emergency services, department of environmental conservation, and department of transportation about certain freight rail trains
sponsored.sum: Requires railroad corporations to inform the division of homeland security and emergency services, department of environmental conservation and department of transportation about freight rail trains transporting hazardous materials prior to traveling on tracks within the state.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Appalachian Trail
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of state highway 284 in the village of Unionville, county of Orange, to the Appalachian Trail.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain death benefits to deputy sheriffs employed by Orange county
sponsored.sum: Provides for certain death benefits to deputy sheriffs employed by Orange county.

sponsored.t: Relates to the transfer and conveyance of certain property to the town of Goshen
sponsored.sum: Relates to the transfer and conveyance of certain property located on the Mid-Hudson Forensic Psychiatric Center campus to the town of Goshen.

sponsored.t: Relates to license fees required to be paid by wholesale beer licensees to sell cider
sponsored.sum: Requires wholesale beer licensees to only need to pay a one time additional license fee to sell cider.

sponsored.t: Provides notice regarding the timeliness of the receipt by the board of elections of ballots capable of return by mail
sponsored.sum: Provides notice regarding the timeliness of the receipt by the board of elections of ballots capable of return by mail to advise voters that such ballot should be returned to the board of elections as soon as possible by any approved method, and further recommend the use of alternative methods of return besides domestic mail services if the voter will be returning their ballot within several days of the election.

sponsored.t: Dedicates portion of the state highway system to Detective Brian C. Mulkeen
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Woodbury, county of Orange, to Detective Brian C. Mulkeen.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities to establish an emergency repair pilot program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to establish an emergency repair pilot program; enables municipalities to repair immediately hazardous code violations in buildings where the owner has not undertaken such repairs in a reasonable time.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Michael Winston Hoard, the widower of Kathy Marie Dwyer-Hoard, to file a new service retirement application and election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Michael Winston Hoard, the widower of Kathy Marie Dwyer-Hoard, to file a new service retirement application and an option election form on behalf of his deceased wife with the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Permits unvented attics and unvented enclosed rafter assemblies to be sealed with air-impermeable insulation in order to help attain building decarbonization goals
sponsored.sum: Permits unvented attics and unvented enclosed rafter assemblies to be sealed with air-impermeable insulation in order to help attain building decarbonization goals.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Susan Gillinder, the widow of Robert C. Ritchie, to file a new service retirement application and election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Susan Gillinder, the widow of Robert C. Ritchie, to file a new service retirement application and an option election form on behalf of her deceased husband with the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Enacts the psychology interjurisdictional compact
sponsored.sum: Adopts the psychology interjurisdictional compact to increase public access to psychological services by allowing telepsychological practice and temporary in-person services across state lines.

sponsored.t: Requires merchants to round cash purchases to the nearest five cent denomination in order to reduce the circulation of pennies within New York state
sponsored.sum: Requires merchants to round cash purchases to the nearest five cent denomination in order to encourage the reduction of the circulation of pennies within New York state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes retail licensees to purchase alcohol with a business payment
sponsored.sum: Authorizes retail licensees to purchase alcohol with a business payment card.

sponsored.t: Includes Stewart International Airport in the definition of covered airport location for the purposes of minimum wage rates
sponsored.sum: Includes Stewart International Airport in the definition of covered airport location for the purposes of minimum wage rates.

sponsored.t: Requires colleges in the state to communicate all absentee deadlines for New York state elections
sponsored.sum: Requires colleges in the state to communicate all absentee deadlines for New York state elections to all enrolled students.

sponsored.t: Provides for mental health counseling for correction officers and civilian staff in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision, in consultation with the commissioner of mental health, to make mental health counseling available to all correction officers and civilian staff in correctional facilities.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange county
sponsored.sum: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange county.

sponsored.t: Allows brewery supply stores to sell New York state labelled beer for off-premises consumption
sponsored.sum: Allows brewery supply stores to sell New York state labelled beer for off-premises consumption.

sponsored.t: Relates to conducting investigations into the administration and enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and the New York state energy conservation construction code
sponsored.sum: Relates to conducting investigations into the administration and enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and the New York state energy conservation construction code by counties.

sponsored.t: Waives fishing, hunting and trapping license fees for certain first responders
sponsored.sum: Waives fishing, hunting and trapping license fees for certain first responders.

sponsored.t: Increases the period of supervision required for certain real estate license applications
sponsored.sum: Increases the period of supervision to four years for real estate brokers applying for a license.

sponsored.t: Relates to the maximum allowable timeframes to respond to requests for records under the freedom of information act
sponsored.sum: Relates to the maximum allowable timeframes to respond to requests for records under the freedom of information act.

sponsored.t: Requires the results of any outage management system stress test conducted in the state by a utility company to be posted online
sponsored.sum: Requires the results of any outage management system stress test conducted in the state by a utility company to be posted online and such results to be sent to the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly and the chairs of the senate and assembly standing committees on energy.

sponsored.t: Authorizes county highway superintendents to rent road machinery from any city, town or village and authorizes town highway superintendents to contract for the use of town machinery, tools and equipment
sponsored.sum: Authorizes county highway superintendents to rent road machinery from any city, town or village; authorizes town highway superintendents to contract for the use of certain services and town machinery, tools and equipment with another municipality, district corporation, school district, community college or any unit of the state university.

sponsored.t: Allows for NYSTRS retirees to change their retirement plan beneficiary to a spouse at any time either prior to or after retirement
sponsored.sum: Allows for NYSTRS retirees to change their retirement plan beneficiary to a spouse at any time either prior to or after retirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to voting of overseas military voters and special federal voters
sponsored.sum: Authorizes electronic absentee ballot applications for military voters and special federal voters; removes requirements that the federal post card application form be included with certain ballot application and ballots; requires institutions of higher education to provide students studying abroad with information on how to vote from abroad.

sponsored.t: Relates to third-party network contracts
sponsored.sum: Allows dental provider networks, certain health and hospital service corporations, and health care plans to enter into contracts with a third party to gain access to services and discounted rates of a provider under a provider network contract.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities in the county of Orange to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such municipalities' annual tax levy
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities in the county of Orange to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such municipalities' annual tax levy in accordance with applicable law.

sponsored.t: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to disclose to residents and their families
sponsored.sum: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to separately disclose to residents and their families; requires such information to be posted on the residential health care facility's website.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of chapter 435 of the laws of 2014 relating to defining spearguns and allowing recreational spearfishing in New York's marine and coastal waters
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to defining spearguns and allowing recreational spearfishing in New York's marine and coastal waters.

sponsored.t: Requires state and county boards of elections to post sample ballots online at least twelve days prior to the first day of early voting
sponsored.sum: Requires state and county boards of elections to post sample ballots online at least twelve days prior to the first day of early voting; requires such ballots to be posted in a searchable database.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain fees from being imposed by licensed wholesalers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain fees from being imposed by licensed wholesalers on licensed retailers.

sponsored.t: Relates to defining "period of war" for the alternative veterans' exemption
sponsored.sum: Defines "period of war" for the alternative veterans' exemption.

sponsored.t: Relates to limits on amount of flood insurance required by a mortgagee
sponsored.sum: Sets the definition of "principal" for the purposes of limits on amount of flood insurance required by a mortgagee; clarifies applicability of the state law relative to certain federal programs and requirements.

sponsored.t: Creates a special on-premises license for certain properties
sponsored.sum: Creates a special on-premises license for properties which are located within a designated industrial or economic zoning district, occupy not less than twenty thousand square feet of floor area, and are located at least 500 feet from a residential building.

sponsored.t: Removes the requirement for registration stickers on certain motor vehicles and provides for the issuance of electronic certificates of registration for certain motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement for registration stickers on certain motor vehicles; provides for the issuance of electronic certificates of registration for certain motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Reduces electric corporations' response time for securing downed wires
sponsored.sum: Requires each utility to take appropriate safety precautions regarding electrical hazards, including developing plans to promptly de-energize downed wires within two hours of notification of the location of such downed wires from a municipal emergency responder and promptly secure such wires within six hours in the case of events that are not considered emergencies.

sponsored.t: Requires a municipality to give notice to an adjacent municipality of the adoption or amendment of certain zoning ordinances or local laws that affect parcels of land within 500 feet of the adjacent municipal
sponsored.sum: Requires a municipality to give notice to an adjacent municipality of the adoption or amendment of certain zoning ordinances or local laws that affect parcels of land within 500 feet of the adjacent municipality.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring utility companies maintain a toll free number for reporting service outages
sponsored.sum: Requires utility companies maintain a toll free number for consumers to call to report service outages which shall be made available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of taxation and finance to create and implement an online program which will enable New York state taxpayers to electronically file income tax returns free of charge
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of taxation and finance to create and implement an online program which will enable each New York state taxpayer to prepare and electronically file such taxpayer's federal and state income tax returns free of charge.

sponsored.t: Establishes certification and attestation for care managers employed by care coordination organizations
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Ella's law"; requires care managers employed by or under contract with a care coordination organization to provide care management services to an individual unless such care manager has completed all training requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to pricing changes for online grocery delivery and online pick-up services
sponsored.sum: Requires the clear and conspicuous disclosure of pricing changes for online grocery delivery and online pick-up services; imposes a fine of not more than one hundred dollars for the first offense and not more than two hundred fifty dollars for a second and each subsequent offense for violations.

sponsored.t: Recognizes suicide as a line of duty death for the purposes of certain death benefits
sponsored.sum: Recognizes suicide as a line of duty death for the purposes of certain death benefits for public safety officers.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "ICE contract transparency act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "ICE contract transparency act"; creates a publicly accessible database for contracts made between United States immigration and customs enforcement and private entities conducting business in the state of New York; requires entities to provide the department of state with a copy of contracts made between U.S. immigration and customs enforcement and private entities operating in the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the recall of class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the recall of a class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS; relates to the destruction of PFAS chemicals.

sponsored.t: Relates to the continuation of the empire state stem cell board
sponsored.sum: Relates to the continuation of the empire state stem cell board; makes such provisions of law permanent.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring children enrolled in an overnight camp, children's summer day camp, or travelling summer day camp to be vaccinated
sponsored.sum: Requires children enrolled in an overnight camp, summer day camp, or travelling summer day camp to be vaccinated against a specified list of diseases.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the town of Cornwall in Orange county to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the town of Cornwall in Orange county to impose a hotel and motel tax by three years.

sponsored.t: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold
sponsored.sum: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold; provides that any manufacturer, dealer, or agent of a manufacturer or dealer that fails to comply with such requirements shall be assessed a civil penalty not to exceed two hundred fifty dollars per point of sale for each violation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the prohibition of lending institutions issuing unsolicited mail-loan checks
sponsored.sum: Relates to the prohibition of lending institutions issuing mail-loan checks except in response to an affirmative request or application therefor; provides that any debt, interest, fee or other obligation arising from a mail-loan check issued in violation of this section shall be null and void and unenforceable.

sponsored.t: Requires the use of reclaimed asphalt pavement
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of at least thirty percent reclaimed asphalt pavement for certain construction projects.

sponsored.t: Enacts into law components of legislation that relate to live event ticket sales
sponsored.sum: Enacts into law components of legislation that relate to live event ticket sales; establishes an annual professional reseller renewal fee; requires professional ticket resellers to provide their New York state ticket reseller license number as a condition of utilizing an online resale marketplace to resell tickets (Part A); provides criteria for when a purchaser may obtain a full refund of the amount paid for a ticket (Part B); relates to resale requirements for tickets; requires that if a licensee or other ticket reseller doesn't have possession of the ticket, then they shall have a written contract to obtain the offered ticket at a certain price from a person or entity in possession of…

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Terminate Excessive Cross-state Actuarial Subsidization (TEXAS) Act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Terminate Excessive Cross-state Actuarial Subsidization (TEXAS) Act" which requires life insurance companies to take state specific population health information into account as a factor; requires the superintendent of financial services to develop a standard weight to be given to state specific population health information in rate-setting.

sponsored.t: Requires that nuisance wildlife control operators disclose to the client that euthanasia may be used to resolve a wildlife related problem
sponsored.sum: Requires that nuisance wildlife control operators disclose to the client, in writing, that euthanasia may be used to resolve a wildlife related problem.

sponsored.t: Establishes a procedure for appointing a president or chairperson upon a vacancy of such position
sponsored.sum: Establishes a procedure for appointing a president or chairperson upon a vacancy of such position.

sponsored.t: Requires insurers to disclose all available endorsements for homeowners liability insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers to disclose all available endorsements for homeowners' liability insurance policies with plain language descriptions of the coverage added by each endorsement as part of the application process.

sponsored.t: Requires insurers and health plans to grant automatic preauthorization approvals to eligible health care professionals in certain circumstance
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers and health plans to grant automatic preauthorization approvals to eligible health care professionals in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to waiving school taxes by a town, city, or county industrial development agency
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a town, city, or county industrial development agency from waiving taxes which would be received by a school district.

sponsored.t: Relates to financial assistance from an industrial development agency; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions related to requiring projects be located in a highly distressed area in order to qualify for certain financial assistance from an industrial development agency.

sponsored.t: Relates to reviews by the authorities budget office
sponsored.sum: Relates to reviews by the authorities budget office; grants the authorities budget office the authority to commence an action or special proceeding to annul the corporate existence or dissolve a corporation that has acted beyond its capacity or power; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages and retail licensees
sponsored.sum: Modifies licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages on licensees who sell at retail for on premises consumption, and restrictions on retail licensees interested directly or indirectly in licensed manufacturers or wholesalers of alcoholic beverages.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of pharmacy and administration of immunizations
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a licensed pharmacist to administer flu immunizations to persons nine years of age or older.

sponsored.t: Relates to the publication of immunization information
sponsored.sum: Relates to the publication of immunization information; requires schools to provide immunization information to the commissioner of health; requires the department of health to make immunization information, including rates of immunization, available on its website.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the fees certain notaries public shall be entitled to
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the fees certain notaries public shall be entitled to from two dollars to five dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the use of funds, financial incentives or subsidies where facilities or property are used primarily for e-commerce storage and transfers, or the facilitation thereof
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting the use of funds, financial incentives or subsidies where facilities or property are used primarily for e-commerce storage and transfers, or the facilitation thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the available jurisdiction for issuing information subpoenas
sponsored.ls: New York City Civil Court Act
sponsored.sum: Allows for the issuance of information subpoenas on behalf of small claims judgment creditors to be effective anywhere in the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to pro bono service by attorneys and candidates for admission to the bar
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a requirement of pro bono service as a condition of admission to the bar or attorney registration; exempts pro bono work performed pursuant to an agreement with the federal government if the federal government designates the recipients of the pro bono work or type or types or nature of such legal services; provides for the expiration of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to assessment and taxation of lessees and users of certain tax exempt property
sponsored.sum: Subjects to taxation the possessory interest of a private individual or corporation which uses real property owned by the United States or the state, except for real property owned by public authorities, for business purposes; excludes private property where the use is for a concession available to the general public located on property, such as parks, available for the use of the general public.

sponsored.t: Prohibits insurance discrimination on the basis of an insured's marital status following the death of the insured's spouse
sponsored.sum: Prohibits insurance discrimination on the basis of an insured's marital status following the death of the insured's spouse.

sponsored.t: Adds animal fighting to the definition of criminal activity for purposes of enterprise corruption crimes
sponsored.sum: Includes animal fighting as a criminal act for purposes of enterprise corruption crimes.

sponsored.t: Requires certain non-licensed professionals to disclose information regarding risks
sponsored.sum: Requires self-help practitioners to disclose information to clients regarding risks and to produce a risk management plan.

sponsored.t: Relates to posting financial disclosure filings for candidates for statewide elected office or candidate for a member of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Relates to the annual statement of financial disclosure and the posting of financial disclosure filings for candidates for statewide elected office or candidates for a member of the legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to the eligibility criteria for the excelsior jobs program act
sponsored.sum: Requires a business entity in violation of worker protection or environmental laws and regulations to surrender all previous state subsidies issued to such business entity.

sponsored.t: Relates to off premise retail license holders
sponsored.sum: Relates to off premise retail license holders; increases the number of licenses authorized under section 63 of the alcoholic beverage control law from one to two licenses.

sponsored.t: Allows industrial development agencies to make grants to municipalities for open space preservation, parkland improvements and conservation easements
sponsored.sum: Allows industrial development agencies to make grants to municipalities for open space preservation, parkland improvements and conservation easements where the municipal governing body finds that the grant encourages tourism or otherwise improves quality of life.

sponsored.t: Allows for justices to reside in any town, village or city within the same assembly district as the court such justice serves and establishes educational requirements for certain town and village justices
sponsored.sum: Allows for justices to reside in any town, village or city contained in whole or in part within the same assembly district as the court such justice serves or in an assembly district contiguous to such municipality where the court is located; authorizes towns and villages to require that any person who serves as a town or village justice be admitted to practice law in the state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and empowers each municipality of the state and the department of transportation to implement a program for imposing fines for littering using photo violation-monitoring systems
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and empowers each municipality of the state and the department of transportation to implement a program for imposing fines for littering using photo violation-monitoring systems.

sponsored.t: Establishes a requirement for information related to specialized dental benefit plans
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers and corporations that issue, sell, renew or offer a specialized dental benefits plan policy or contract to report annually on data related to such dental benefits plan policies.

sponsored.t: Relates to making restaurant and bar patios one hundred percent smoke free; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to making restaurant and bar patios one hundred percent smoke free.

sponsored.t: Relates to the minimum wage for employees with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Eliminates provisions exempting employees with disabilities from the minimum wage law; provides that laws or minimum wage orders that authorize an employer to pay a wage that is less than the minimum wage are valid provided that under such laws or orders an employee with a disability is paid the same wage as an employee in a comparable position that does not have a disability.

sponsored.t: Requires manufactured home park owners to provide a written justification for rent increases in excess of three percent of the current rent
sponsored.sum: Requires manufactured home park owners to provide a written justification for rent increases in excess of three percent of the current rent; provides that increases in costs to justify such rent increase for ordinary maintenance or repair to meet the warranty of habitability obligations must be shown to be necessary.
sponsored.fis: Anticipated savings for local governments by consolidating various elections at different times of the year on election day in even-num- bered years.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York city employees' retirement system to Ryan D. O'Connor
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York city employees' retirement system to Ryan D. O'Connor.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement benefits for members of the NYC police pension fund
sponsored.sum: Provides that service retirement benefits for members of the NYC police pension fund shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

sponsored.t: Prohibits recording of the entrance of a school ground
sponsored.sum: Prohibits recording of the entrance or exit of a school ground or the entrance or exit to a property that contains school grounds within its boundaries.

sponsored.t: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; and makes conforming technical changes
sponsored.sum: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; provides additional definitions; provides remedies for violations of the code; makes conforming technical changes.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study of recess held in elementary schools in kindergarten through grade six
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study of recess held in elementary schools in kindergarten through grade six.

sponsored.t: Keeps professional sports franchises in their home communities
sponsored.sum: Keeps professional sports franchises in their home communities by requiring franchise owners offer the franchise for sale prior to relocating or eliminating the franchise.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing body scanner utilization in certain facilities under the office of children and family services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of body imaging scanning equipment in certain facilities for youth and adolescent offenders placed with or committed to the office of children and family services.
sponsored.fis: None; purchases of body scanners would be made from existing agency appropriations. Cost savings are anticipated in reduced workers' compen- sation claims; reduced medical costs for youth and staff injuries; lower staff termination and disciplinary hearings costs; and reduction of the need to employ local and State law enforcement agencies to respond to suspicions of or actual contraband.

sponsored.t: Restricts the use of prediction markets and/or mobile sports wagering platforms by certain public officers when using information acquired by such person in the course of their official duties
sponsored.sum: Restricts the use of prediction markets and/or mobile sports wagering platforms by officers or employees of a state agency, members of the legislature or legislative employees when using information acquired by such public officer in the course of their official duties.

sponsored.t: Requires all certified first responders, emergency medical technicians, and advanced emergency medical technicians to undergo criminal background checks
sponsored.sum: Requires all certified first responders, emergency medical technicians, and advanced emergency medical technicians to undergo criminal background checks to maintain their certification.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of transportation establishes an interactive website for reporting defects on public highways
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of transportation to establish an interactive website for reporting defects on public highways.

sponsored.t: Establishes a private right of action against mental health professionals who engaged in sexual orientation change efforts and revives such actions otherwise barred by the existing statute of limitations
sponsored.sum: Establishes a private right of action against mental health professionals who engaged in sexual orientation change efforts, revives such actions otherwise barred by the existing statute of limitations and grants trial preference to such actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating the fourth Thursday in March as "Tuskegee Airmen Commemoration Day"
sponsored.sum: Designates the fourth Thursday in March as "Tuskegee Airmen Commemoration Day".

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting rate increases that entail a return on equity for capital projects
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the public service commission from approving a rate increase that entails a return on equity for capital projects that is above the prevailing ten-year treasury rate plus one percent.

sponsored.t: Permits the town of Warwick to use preservation funds for water quality improvement
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Warwick to utilize preservation funds for the implementation of water quality improvement projects.

sponsored.t: Relates to publishing records of public interest by agencies and the legislature
sponsored.sum: Relates to publishing records of public interest by agencies and the legislature on their websites.

sponsored.t: Ends the local option of towns and cities to prohibit the sale of alcohol; repealer
sponsored.sum: Ends the local option of towns and cities to prohibit the sale of alcohol.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the authority of the attorney general to investigate violations of the public officers law
sponsored.sum: Expands the authority of the attorney general to investigate violations of the public officers law.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain persons from receiving compensation for legal fees, consulting, or other work performed for an industrial development agency or an economic assistance corporation
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain persons from receiving compensation for legal fees, consulting, or other work performed for an industrial development agency, an economic assistance corporation or state or local authority; relates to consultant disclosure requirements.

sponsored.t: Requires hotels and lodging facilities to contact certain guests who leave items or identifying documents behind
sponsored.sum: Requires hotels and lodging facilities to make at least two attempts to contact guests who leave any item of greater than nominal value or identification documents behind within 48 hours of the completion of their stay where such guest chose to be contacted for such reasons; requires the destruction of any identification documents if the owner cannot be contacted; limits the liability of a lodging owner or operator for damage or loss during shipping.

sponsored.t: authorizing Liliana Fernandez-Clemente, the widow of Daniel Clemente, to file a new service retirement application and option election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Liliana Fernandez-Clemente, the widow of Daniel Clemente, to file a new service retirement application and option election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system on behalf of such deceased member.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability retirement benefits for the presumption of cancer affecting the endocrine and thyroid systems and Parkinson's Disease for certain firefighters
sponsored.sum: Relates to disability retirement benefits for the presumption of cancer affecting the endocrine and thyroid systems and Parkinson's Disease for certain firefighters.

sponsored.t: Relation to the state's liability for damages caused by defects on state roads
sponsored.sum: Imposes liability on the state for injuries or damage sustained by persons while traveling on state highways, if the same are caused by a defect or dangerous condition that the state had notice of, but did not repair.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting a plaintiff to recover directly against a third party defendant found to be liable in certain actions
sponsored.sum: Permits a plaintiff to recover directly against a third party defendant found to be liable to the defendant in certain actions.

sponsored.t: Requires immediate notification of a child's parent when an allegation of child abuse in an educational setting has been made regarding such child
sponsored.sum: Requires immediate notification of a child's parent when an allegation of child abuse in an educational setting has been made regarding such child.

sponsored.t: In relation to enrollment eligibility for election officials in the address confidentiality program
sponsored.sum: Permits enrollment in the address confidentiality program for election officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the applicability of open meetings and freedom of information laws to certain not-for-profit corporations
sponsored.sum: Relates to the applicability of open meetings and freedom of information laws to certain not-for-profit corporations.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health insurance policies include coverage for services provided by pharmacists related to contraceptives
sponsored.sum: Requires certain health insurance policies include coverage for services provided by pharmacists related to contraceptives.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Redeveloping Empty and Vacant Infrastructure for Vibrant Economies Act or the REVIVE Act
sponsored.sum: Provides for the adaptive reuse of certain parcels which are zoned for commercial, office, retail, or parking.

sponsored.t: Relates to the timing of annual tax elections
sponsored.sum: Relates to the timing of annual tax elections and the amount of the required installments.
sponsored.fis: The PTET was designed to be revenue-neutral to the state, and this legislation will have no impact on total state revenues. The legislation would provide a modest financial benefit to the state based on the tech- nical components of how the tax works. Specifically, the tax rate appli- cable to many flow-through entities is higher than the personal income tax rate payable by the underlying owners of the entity. This tax over- age is ultimately refunded to the partners, but the State essentially gets an interest-free loan from PTET participants.

sponsored.t: Increases benefits for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Increases benefits for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes retired firefighters to be employed as fire science instructors by career and technical education centers without a reduction of benefits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes retired firefighters to be employed as fire science instructors by career and technical education centers without a reduction of their retirement benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to outdoor alcohol service for certain special events
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the liquor authority to permit outdoor alcohol service for certain special events occurring in June and July, 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the definition of agency
sponsored.sum: Relates to expanding the definition of agency; includes entities created by an agency or that are governed by a board of directors or similar body a majority of which is designated by one or more state or local government officials in the definition of agency under the public officers law.

sponsored.t: Establishes a process for designating transfer-on-death beneficiaries for farming implements
sponsored.sum: Establishes a process for designating transfer-on-death beneficiaries for farming implements involving filing a document with the commissioner of agriculture and markets.

sponsored.t: Requires electronic filing of all lobbying filings
sponsored.sum: Requires electronic filing of all lobbying filings with the commission on ethics and lobbying in government.

sponsored.t: Requires the comptroller review and approve certain contracts
sponsored.sum: Requires the comptroller review and approve all contracts above a minimum contract value set by the legislature.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain nursing students to administer certain vaccines
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain nursing students to administer certain vaccines pursuant to patient specific orders or non-patient specific orders; authorizes physicians and certified nurse practitioners to prescribe and order a patient specific order or non-patient specific order to a nursing student to administer certain vaccines.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance reimbursement for cost of vaccinations
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance reimbursement for the total direct and indirect practice expenses associated with vaccinations.

sponsored.t: Creates an electric school bus infrastructure investment pilot program
sponsored.sum: Creates an electric school bus infrastructure investment pilot program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of the Comprehensive School Resource Officer Training and Implementation Program (SRO TIP)
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York state school resource officer program for school districts outside of New York City; requires retired police officers be certified by the department of education to become school resource officers; allows retired police officers employed as school resource officers to carry a firearm on school grounds given an appropriate license; relates to the earnings limitations for retired police officers employed as a school resource officer.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the issuing of major renewable energy and major electric transmission facility siting permits in designated grassland bird conservation centers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the issuing of major renewable energy and major electric transmission facility siting permits in designated grassland bird conservation centers including, but not limited to, three such centers in Jefferson county, one center in Saint Lawrence county, the Oak-Orchard-Iroquois center, the Washington County Grasslands center, the Finger Lakes National Forest center and the Shawangunk Grasslands.

sponsored.t: Expands the solar energy system equipment tax credit to cover solar energy system equipment installed in a community solar array
sponsored.sum: Expands the solar energy system equipment tax credit to cover solar energy system equipment installed in a community solar array; defines "community solar array" to mean a location other than a person's principal residence where solar energy system equipment is owned and installed for use in such person's principal residence.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of trawling, gill nets, and trammel nets except for scientific purposes; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of trawling, gill nets, and trammel nets except for scientific purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to subcontracted facilitators of the statewide fiscal intermediary
sponsored.sum: Relates to subcontracted facilitators of the statewide fiscal intermediary.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary New York craft beverage permit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary New York craft beverage permit for all New York state manufactured liquor, spirits, wine, beer, cider and mead for events located in a municipality with a population of less than one million.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting participation by certain public or quasi-public organizations in the retirement system
sponsored.sum: Relates to limiting participation by certain public or quasi-public organizations in the retirement system.

sponsored.t: Expands the ability of certain persons who sell alcohol to set the price of said alcohol
sponsored.sum: Expands the ability of certain persons who sell alcohol to set the price of said alcohol.
sponsored.fis: Modest operational savings by the SLA.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing county correction officers with a special optional twenty year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing county correction officers with a special optional twenty year retirement plan.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a wholesale prescription drug importation program
sponsored.sum: Creates a wholesale prescription drug importation program which complies with federal standards and regulations for the purpose of generating substantial savings for consumers.

sponsored.t: Requires that in the event a complaint made to local code enforcement results in the issuance of a compliance order, the complainant shall also be provided a copy of such order
sponsored.sum: Requires that when a complaint is made to local code enforcement of a violation of the uniform fire prevention and building code or a local code which results in the issuance of a compliance order, the complainant shall also be provided a copy of such order.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of court administration to publish an annual report regarding cases involving property/casualty insurance companies and insureds
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of court administration to publish an annual report regarding cases involving property/casualty insurance companies and insureds.

sponsored.t: Requires prior approval of certain rates; requires insurers provide written explanations for certain premium increases; and authorizes the refiling of certain rates
sponsored.sum: Requires rate filings for prior approval for commercial property insurance, commercial general liability insurance, and personal residential property insurance; requires insurers provide written explanations for premium increases in certain covered policies; requires certain insurers of homeowners' insurance to refile its homeowners' insurance rates and, in certain circumstances, be required to reduce rates.

sponsored.t: Enacts the voices of immigrant communities empowering survivors (VOICES) act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Voices of Immigrant Communities Empowering Survivors (VOICES) Act which provides certification to certain immigrant victims of qualifying criminal activity.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain continuing education courses to be completed online
sponsored.sum: Authorizes continuing education courses for hearing aid dispensers and home inspectors to be completed online.

sponsored.t: Adds members to the board of trustees of the state university of New York who represent the interests of community colleges
sponsored.sum: Adds members to the board of trustees of the state university of New York who represent the interests of community colleges as full voting members of the board of trustees; provides that the local legislative body or board of the county in which a community college is located may appoint a trustee in the event that the governor fails to appoint such trustee within 180 days of a vacancy on a board of trustees of a community college.

sponsored.t: Provides confidentiality for communications arising out of law enforcement peer support counseling
sponsored.sum: Provides confidentiality for communications arising out of law enforcement peer support counseling.

sponsored.t: Relates to the kinds of insurance with respect to which a rental vehicle company or peer-to-peer car sharing program administrator may act as an agent for an authorized insurer
sponsored.sum: Provides that a rental vehicle company or peer-to-peer car sharing program administrator may act as an agent for an authorized insurer with respect to accident and health insurance that provides coverage to shared vehicle owners, shared vehicle drivers, or a combination thereof, and any other coverage that the superintendent of financial services may approve as meaningful and appropriate in connection with the sharing of a shared vehicle.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of health to enter into a contract for the digitalization and indexing of certain vital records
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to enter into a contract with an entity experienced in maintaining genealogical research databases for the digitalization and indexing of certain vital records.

sponsored.t: Provides for the preservation of the names and geographic areas of hamlets following the consolidation of local government entities
sponsored.sum: Provides for the preservation of the names and geographic areas of hamlets following the consolidation of local government entities.

sponsored.t: Establishes the mobile and manufactured home replacement program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the mobile and manufactured home replacement program to eliminate older mobile and manufactured homes and replace them with new manufactured, modular or site-built homes; makes related provisions.
sponsored.fis: This program would be funded subject to annual appropriations made through the State budget.

sponsored.t: Directs the state fire prevention and building code council to update the state fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code
sponsored.sum: Directs the state fire prevention and building code council to update the state fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code within 18 months of the publication of any updated or revised edition of the international and national codes relating thereto, so as to ensure that the state's codes reflect such revisions and updates.

sponsored.t: Permits union free and central school district boards of education to establish wards for the purpose of school board elections in Orange County
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the boards of education in union free school districts and central school districts to establish wards for the purpose of school board elections in Orange County.

sponsored.t: Increases the number of package store licenses able to be held by one person
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of package store licenses able to be held by one person to two; permits certain licensees to buy and sell from other certain licensees.
sponsored.fis: New license revenues to the SLA.

sponsored.t: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to the gubernatorial absence provision
sponsored.sum: Relates to gubernatorial and lieutenant-gubernatorial absences.

sponsored.t: Relates to the filling of vacancies in the office of lieutenant-governor
sponsored.sum: Requires vacancies in the office of lieutenant-governor to be filled within certain timeframes and procedures.

sponsored.t: Relates to declaring inabilities of the governor, lieutenant-governor and acting governor
sponsored.sum: Relates to declaring inabilities of the governor, lieutenant-governor and acting governor; creates the committee on gubernatorial inability.

sponsored.t: Relates to the line of succession for the governor and lieutenant-governor
sponsored.sum: Relates to the line of succession for the governor and lieutenant-governor in cases where they are impeached or unable to perform the duties of the office.

sponsored.t: Establishes term limits for the governor and lieutenant-governor
sponsored.sum: Establishes term limits for the governor and lieutenant-governor of three terms in such office.

sponsored.t: Requires disclosure of information concerning non-invasive prenatal screening for chromosomal abnormalities
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure of information concerning non-invasive prenatal screening for chromosomal abnormalities including the benefits and limitations of non-invasive prenatal testing, the difference between non-invasive prenatal testing and prenatal diagnostic testing, and current recommendations from the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG), the Society for Maternal Fetal Medicine, and the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG).
sponsored.fis: Minimal costs to the Department of Health to be determined.

sponsored.t: Revokes the public pension of a public officer who stands convicted on an impeachment
sponsored.sum: Revokes the public pension of a public officer who stands convicted on an impeachment; applies retroactively.
sponsored.fis: None other than possible savings to the state pension fund.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the governor from granting themselves or any person involved with furthering the illegal conduct of the governor a reprieve, commutation or pardon
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the governor from granting themselves or any person involved with furthering the illegal conduct of the governor a reprieve, commutation or pardon.

sponsored.t: Requires elections and terms of certain officials occur on even-numbered years
sponsored.sum: Requires certain elections take place in even-numbered years for certain municipal and judicial officials.

sponsored.t: Renames the supreme court the superior court and the court of appeals the supreme court
sponsored.sum: Renames the supreme court the superior court and the court of appeals the supreme court.

sponsored.t: Requires school districts and other facilities providing universal prekindergarten programs utilize all allotted funds for universal prekindergarten programs
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts and other facilities providing universal prekindergarten programs utilize all allotted funds for universal prekindergarten programs.

sponsored.t: Requires certain kratom products to include a warning label
sponsored.sum: Requires certain kratom products to include a warning label with disclosures including, but not limited to, that kratom may be addictive and to keep it out of reach of children.

sponsored.t: Extends the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county industrial development agency and modifies the applicability of certain tax exemptions based on population
sponsored.sum: Extends the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county industrial development agency; requires such monitor also monitor the Orange county funding corporation; modifies the applicability of certain tax exemptions based on population; extends provisions of law related to the independent monitor for the Orange county industrial development agency.

sponsored.t: Moves the date of the presidential primary to the first Tuesday in March
sponsored.sum: Moves the date of the presidential primary to the first Tuesday in March, also known as Super Tuesday.

sponsored.t: Establishes a specialized electric vehicle emergency response training program
sponsored.sum: Requires the state fire administrator to make available a specialized electric vehicle emergency response training program to provide training to individuals responsible for providing emergency response and recovery following incidents involving electric vehicles; defines emergency medical services agency.

sponsored.t: Permits the compounding, dispensing and sale of veterinary-specific pharmaceuticals to veterinarians by pharmacists
sponsored.sum: Permits the compounding, dispensing and sale of veterinary-specific pharmaceuticals to veterinarians by pharmacists.

sponsored.t: Enacts into law components of legislation that relate to live event ticket sales
sponsored.sum: Enacts into law components of legislation that relate to live event ticket sales; institutes civil penalties for utilizing ticket purchasing software; institutes new penalties for second offenses for licensees and for any person, firm, corporation or entity who is made aware of the utilization of ticket purchasing software and does not notify the attorney general of such utilization (Part A); establishes an annual professional reseller renewal fee; requires professional ticket resellers to provide their New York state ticket reseller license number as a condition of utilizing an online resale marketplace to resell tickets (Part B); provides criteria for when a purchaser may obtain a full…

sponsored.t: Imposes a tax related to executive compensation
sponsored.sum: Requires that certain companies pay an annual tax if the chief executive receives compensation 100 to 250 times greater than the median pay of all their employees.

sponsored.t: Requires certain elections of public officials occur on even-numbered years
sponsored.sum: Requires certain elections of public officials occur on even-numbered years.

sponsored.t: Relates to discrimination against vaccinated persons
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination against vaccinated persons.

sponsored.t: Relates to making certain public records available on the internet
sponsored.sum: Requires governmental and certain nongovernmental entities to publish public records proactively on the internet that are of public interest.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of biometric identity verification devices for the purchase of alcoholic beverages and tobacco products
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of biometric identity verification devices for the purchase of alcoholic beverages and tobacco products; authorizes a licensee, its agent or employee to determine a person's age when purchasing alcoholic beverages or tobacco products by use of a biometric identity verification device; establishes where the use of the device indicates that the person is under the age of twenty-one, the attempted purchase of the alcoholic beverage shall be denied.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Greenwood Lake, county of Orange to allow golf carts on certain streets
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Greenwood Lake, county of Orange to allow golf carts on certain streets under the exclusive control and jurisdiction of such village.

sponsored.t: Relates to political contributions by corporations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits schedule B contributions on campaign finance filings.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting certain statements relating to sexual abuse or misconduct from disclosure under FOIL
sponsored.sum: Exempts statements of victims and witnesses relating to sexual abuse or misconduct from disclosure under FOIL provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to recurring contributions solicited by a candidate, political campaign, political committee, party committee, or not-for-profit or for-profit entity
sponsored.sum: Provides that entities soliciting a recurring contribution to a political campaign, political committee, party committee, or not-for-profit or for-profit entity shall receive the affirmative consent of the contributor at the time of arrangement of the recurring contribution; provides for refund of recurring contributions; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibition of certain activities in extreme temperatures
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a retail business from directing an employee to engage in human billboard activities during extreme temperatures.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crimes of commercial bribery and larceny
sponsored.sum: Removes the $250 economic harm requirement from the felony commercial bribery statutes; expands the crime of larceny to include theft of personal identifying information, computer data, computer programs, and services, to adapt to modern technological realities; provides state jurisdiction and county venue over cases involving larceny of personal identifying information, computer data, and computer programs, where the victim is located in the state or the county.

sponsored.t: Enables high school students to use public transportation without charge in order to ride to and from school
sponsored.sum: Enables high school students to use public transportation without charge in order to ride to and from school.

sponsored.t: Prohibits awarding TAP grants to those enrolled at for-profit universities
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the awarding of tuition assistance program awards to those enrolled at for-profit universities.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. Ending TAP grants to students enrolled in for-profit institutions would reduce TAP expenditures, although some students who might have otherwise attended for-profit institutions might choose to enroll in a non-profit institution instead.

sponsored.t: Requires the return of certain financial assistance provided for a project where the project has material shortfalls or material violations and preventing the use of incentives for projects already in development
sponsored.sum: Requires the return of all or a part of the financial assistance provided for a project where the project has material shortfalls or material violations; prevents the use of funds, financial incentives, subsidies or tax exemptions for projects already in development.

sponsored.t: Sets a 7 year limit to the real property tax exemption for unimproved property of mandatory class nonprofit organizations
sponsored.sum: Sets a 7-year limit to the real property tax exemption for unimproved property of mandatory class nonprofit organizations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits operation of any motor vehicle equipped with any device which affects the operation of traffic-control signals
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the operation of any motor vehicle equipped with a device which affects the operation of traffic-control signals; provides that the possession of such a device shall constitute a traffic infraction, use thereof is a class A misdemeanor, and use which results in personal injury or death shall constitute a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Creates a work opportunity tax credit
sponsored.sum: Creates a work opportunity tax credit.

sponsored.t: Removes the ability of a board of trustees and mayor to act as the board of assessors
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a member of the board of trustees and the mayor from being appointed to the board of assessors for a village.

sponsored.t: Permits the state and local municipalities to purchase from sources other than the correctional industries program of the department of corrections and community supervision
sponsored.sum: Permits the state and local municipalities to purchase from sources other than the correctional industries program of the department of corrections and community supervision.

sponsored.t: Relates to referrals of certain annexation petitions
sponsored.sum: Requires county planning departments to review specific annexation petitions.

sponsored.t: Relates to metropolitan commuter transportation district registration fee exemptions for farm vehicles
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that farm vehicles pay the metropolitan commuter transportation district (MCTD) supplemental registration fee.

sponsored.t: Provides lifetime, premium-free insurance through the New York state of health marketplace to a person who donates a kidney during the course of their lifetime
sponsored.sum: Provides lifetime, premium-free insurance through the New York state of health marketplace to a person who donates a kidney during the course of their lifetime; establishes the kidney donor insurance fund.
sponsored.fis: There are no direct fiscal implications as a result of this bill. Appropriations to the kidney donor fund would have to be made during the budget process.

sponsored.t: Relates to disallowing county industrial development agencies from offering incentives in municipalities which have their own industrial development agency
sponsored.sum: Disallows county industrial development agencies from offering incentives in municipalities which have their own industrial development agency.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting industrial development agencies from incentivizing movements within the state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits industrial development agencies from incentivizing movements within the state where any plant, facility, or personnel of the project occupant are abandoned or removed.

sponsored.t: Provides for issuing non-driver identification cards to certain persons with suspended driving privileges
sponsored.sum: Issues non-driver identification cards to certain persons with suspended driving privileges due to a driving while intoxicated arrest.

sponsored.t: Requires operators of bicycles, skateboards and in-line skates who are under 18 years of age to wear protective headgear
sponsored.sum: Requires operators of bicycles, skateboards, inline skates and scooters who are under eighteen years of age to wear protective headgear; increases the age requirement from fourteen years to eighteen years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the operation of vehicles that are on approach of vehicles displaying a green or blue light
sponsored.sum: Requires operators of motor vehicles to yield the right of way upon the immediate approach of a vehicle displaying a green or blue light.

sponsored.t: Adds tianeptine sodium to the list of Schedule II of controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Adds tianeptine sodium to list of Schedule II of controlled substances.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purposes and powers of industrial development agencies, local development corporations and certain other not-for-profit corporations and to improving the accountability; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the purposes and powers of industrial development agencies and to improving the accountability and transparency of such agencies; makes conforming changes to the general municipal law; extends the bond issuance charge to the debt issued by not-for-profit corporations acting on behalf of the state or its political subdivisions; relates to the purposes and powers of local development corporations and certain other not-for-profit corporations thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing for students in postsecondary education experience or transition program to receive awards from the tuition assistance program
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing for students in certain postsecondary education experience or transition programs to receive awards from the tuition assistance program.

sponsored.t: Relates to public campaign financing; repealer
sponsored.sum: Amends provisions relating to public campaign financing; changes certain thresholds and procedures; permits retention of matching funds for future use; specifies when a candidate is opposed by a competitive candidate; requires a disclosure on political communications.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the age required to use ultraviolet radiation devices
sponsored.sum: Increases the age required to use ultraviolet radiation devices to twenty-one years of age.

sponsored.t: Requires background checks prior to employment in a position involving substantial contact with children while dressed as a children's character
sponsored.sum: Requires background checks for a person prior to employment in a position involving substantial contact with children while dressed as a children's character; provides certain penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Provides that a fentanyl analogue shall be deemed to be a schedule I opiate
sponsored.sum: Provides that a fentanyl analogue shall be deemed to be a schedule I opiate.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the crime of aggravated harassment of a survivor of domestic violence or sexual assault
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the crime of aggravated harassment of a survivor of domestic violence or sexual assault.

sponsored.t: Limits the naming of municipalities and subdivisions thereof
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the name of municipalities and subdivisions thereof to include the word swastika.

sponsored.t: Requires the disposal of copies of identification documents
sponsored.sum: Requires the disposal of copies of identification documents by owner, lessee, proprietor or manager of any hotel, motel, steamboat, tourist cabins, camp, resort, tavern, inn, boarding or lodging house.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing for unlicensed individuals to collect throat or nasopharyngeal swab specimens and to perform certain nursing tasks during a state of disaster emergency
sponsored.sum: Allows for unlicensed individuals to collect throat or nasopharyngeal swab specimens and to perform certain nursing tasks during a state disaster emergency.

sponsored.t: Specifies watershed protection improvement districts may work towards the preservation of development rights
sponsored.sum: Specifies watershed protection improvement districts may work towards the preservation of development rights.

sponsored.t: Relates to the operating permit program from sources subject to the federal Clean Air Act and power plant emissions and performance standards
sponsored.sum: Relates to the operating permit program from sources subject to the federal Clean Air Act and power plant emissions and performance standards.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for cancer screenings
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring coverage for volunteer firefighters for full cancer screenings upon entry of service to a fire department or fire company and annually thereafter; provides that the costs of such screenings shall be covered by the state.
sponsored.fis: Fiscal implication to the state under Article 2 of the Volunteer Fire- fighters Benefit Law

sponsored.t: Authorizes police agencies to charge fees for searching, copying, and mailing police agency generated records
sponsored.sum: Authorizes police agencies to charge fees for searching, copying, and mailing police agency generated records except for where the requesting party is a victim to or was charged with the crime related to such documents.

sponsored.t: Makes it unlawful for a person under the age of 21 to possess tobacco or vaping products
