sponsored.sum: Makes it unlawful for a person under the age of 21 to possess tobacco or vaping products; provides for a fine not exceeding fifty dollars and/or completion of a tobacco awareness program.

sponsored.t: Withdraws Orange county from the metropolitan commuter transportation district
sponsored.sum: Withdraws Orange county from the metropolitan commuter transportation district.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding W-18 to the schedule of controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Adds W-18(4-chloro-N-{1-{2-(4-nitrophenyl)ethyl} 2piperidinylidene}benzenesulfonamide) to the schedule of controlled substances.

sponsored.t: Relates to abolishing the office of coroner
sponsored.sum: Abolishes the office of coroner.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the provision of licenses for firearms to persons on the federal no-fly list or terrorist screening database
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the provision of licenses for firearms to persons on the federal no-fly list or terrorist screening database; authorizes firearms licenses of persons on the federal no-fly list or terrorist screening database to be suspended or revoked; requires the superintendent of state police to search the federal no-fly list or terrorist screening database each year and report findings to appropriate enforcement agencies in order to suspend or revoke appropriate licenses.

sponsored.t: Establishes school registration and support and assistance for designated schools; repealer
sponsored.sum: Grants the commissioner of education the power to identify schools for additional support and assistance and establish performance targets for such schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring immunization information systems to record data on the number of vaccine exemptions reported by each health care provider
sponsored.sum: Requires immunization information systems to record data on the number of vaccine exemptions reported by each health care provider.

sponsored.t: Requires a call-blocking service to be provided in state contracts that include procurement of a voice service
sponsored.sum: Requires a call-blocking service to be provided in state contracts that include procurement of a voice service; provides that a voice service provider shall not be subject to civil or criminal liability for failure of a call-blocking service to block a call, or mistakenly blocking a call that should not have been blocked.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring principals to notify co-trustees and co-beneficiaries of the signing of a power of attorney
sponsored.sum: Requires principals to make a good faith effort to identify and notify co-trustees and co-beneficiaries of the signing of a power of attorney including the identity of the agent where the agent is not a co-trustee or co-beneficiary.

sponsored.t: Prohibits elected officials from collecting retirement while still in office when the retirement is earned from an elective public office
sponsored.sum: Prohibits elected officials from collecting retirement while still in office when the retirement is earned from an elective public office.

sponsored.t: Repeals the empire state jobs retention program credit
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to the empire state jobs retention program credit.

sponsored.t: Requires third-party verification of an application to receive the Empire State film production credit and the Empire State film post production credit
sponsored.sum: Requires third-party verification of an application to receive the Empire State film production credit and the Empire State film post production credit by approved certified public accountants.

sponsored.t: Increases transparency in certain film production and post-production tax credits
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of economic development issue a quarterly report on film production and post-production tax credits by project and by county in the aggregate and publish such reports on such department's website.

sponsored.t: Relates to fees charged by municipal industrial development agencies
sponsored.sum: Requires fees charged by municipal industrial development agencies be the same as those charged by the county's industrial development agency.

sponsored.t: Enacts tuition-free NY to provide free tuition at SUNY, CUNY and community colleges
sponsored.sum: Makes tuition free for New York state residents at SUNY and CUNY schools and community colleges; requires state residency and employment for a period of five years after completion of academic program.
sponsored.fis: Impact beginning on the first of April next succeeding the date on which it shall have become law.

sponsored.t: Relates to public higher education admissions and standardized testing
sponsored.sum: Prevents certain public institutions of higher education from using the scholastic aptitude test and ACT assessment in the admissions process on and after the two thousand twenty-six--two thousand twenty-seven academic year for New York resident applicants; requires SUNY and CUNY to create a new standardized test by the two thousand thirty--two thousand thirty-one academic year.

sponsored.t: Relates to information cable television companies must provide to subscribers
sponsored.sum: Relates to information cable television companies must provide to subscribers regarding availability of required equipment at retail.

sponsored.t: Eliminates judicial immunity or quasi-judicial immunity for certain third parties who provide a report or finding to the family court
sponsored.sum: Eliminates judicial immunity or quasi-judicial immunity for certain third parties, such as special masters, minor's counsel, investigators, therapists, evaluators, receivers, bankruptcy trustees, experts, and factfinders, who provide a report or finding to the family court.

sponsored.t: Establishes local labor requirements as part of the approval to receive a real property tax business investment exemption
sponsored.sum: Establishes local labor requirements as part of the approval to receive a real property tax business investment exception; requires eighty-five percent of workers hired by a contractor or developer for a project to be from the same county or an adjoining county or, in certain circumstances, the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Eliminates a look-back period for home care for non-institutionalized Medicaid applicants; and repeals a certain provision of the social services law relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the "look-back period" for home care for non-institutionalized Medicaid applicants; repeals a certain provision of law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to downcoding on initial review and audits reversing or altering medical necessity determinations
sponsored.sum: Ensures the decision to downcode an insurance claim is recognized as an adverse determination; prohibits health plans from reversing or altering medical necessity determinations made by a utilization review agent or external appeals agent as a result of an audit of claims.

sponsored.t: Expands which individuals qualify to be an individual's personal assistant for the purposes of consumer directed personal assistance programs
sponsored.sum: Expands which individuals qualify to be an individual's personal assistant for the purposes of consumer directed personal assistance programs to include an eligible individual's attorney-in-fact, health care proxy, or legal guardian.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the crime of public lewdness
sponsored.sum: Adds to the crime of public lewdness the electronic transmission of an image depicting exposed private or intimate parts without the consent of the recipient.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the packaging, sale and distribution of confectionery and candy designed to resemble a tobacco product
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the packaging, sale and distribution of confectionery and candy designed to resemble a tobacco product.

sponsored.t: Prohibits recurring campaign donations without affirmative consent
sponsored.sum: Prohibits recurring campaign donations without affirmative consent; provides that a candidate accepting a recurring contribution shall provide a receipt to the contributor disclosing the terms of the recurring contribution, provide all necessary information to cancel the recurring donation, and immediately cancel the recurring donation upon request.

sponsored.t: Extends the timeline for the return of security deposits for residential rental agreements from fourteen days to thirty days
sponsored.sum: Extends the timeline for the return of security deposits for residential rental agreements from fourteen days to thirty days.

sponsored.t: Establishes the incentive evaluation act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the incentive evaluation act; creates the incentive evaluation commission to at least once every four years evaluate each incentive provided by the state and report to the governor and the legislature on their effectiveness and provide recommendations relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain individuals to file financial disclosure forms
sponsored.sum: Requires certain individuals to file financial disclosure forms.

sponsored.t: Relates to preventing the use of funds, financial incentives, subsidies or tax exemptions for projects with non-public occupants
sponsored.sum: Prevents the use of funds, financial incentives, subsidies or tax exemptions for projects where the occupier of the project is not disclosed.

sponsored.t: Renames the Governor Mario M. Cuomo bridge the Governor Mario M. Cuomo Tappan Zee bridge
sponsored.sum: Renames the Governor Mario M. Cuomo bridge the Governor Mario M. Cuomo Tappan Zee bridge; directs the commissioner of transportation to provide for the installation and maintenance of adequate signing of the state highway system.

sponsored.t: Establishes a no fare program for individuals serving as full-time employees of the New York city transit authority, the Long Island Railroad and the Metro-North Commuter railroad company
sponsored.sum: Establishes a no fare program for individuals serving as full-time employees of the New York city transit authority, the Long Island Railroad and the Metro-North Commuter railroad company.
sponsored.fis: Minor to the New York City Transit Authority, the Long Island Railroad and the Metro-North Commuter railroad company.

sponsored.t: Establishes regional industrial development agencies; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes a single industrial development agency in each region of the state.
sponsored.fis: Minor to the New York City Transit Authority, the Long Island Railroad and the Metro-North Commuter railroad company.

sponsored.t: Designates Xylazine as a schedule III depressant
sponsored.sum: Designates Xylazine as a schedule III depressant.

sponsored.t: Exempts from sales and use tax zero-emission school buses
sponsored.sum: Exempts from sales and use tax zero-emission school buses and any and all parts and pieces of equipment used in their operation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the judicial process relating to a dog that caused death to a companion animal, farm animal or domestic animal while trespassing on property
sponsored.sum: Relates to the judicial process relating to a dog that causes the death of a companion animal, farm animal or domestic animal while trespassing on property.

sponsored.t: Relates to ratifying the proposed amendment to the Constitution of the United States relating to the labor of persons under eighteen years of age
sponsored.sum: Relates to ratifying the proposed amendment to the Constitution of the United States relating to the labor of persons under eighteen years of age.

sponsored.t: Relates to screening and services for dyslexic children
sponsored.sum: Requires screening for dyslexia; provides for intervention services for dyslexic children.

sponsored.t: Authorizes park-and-ride development as construction or improvement by the department of transportation partly at municipal expense
sponsored.sum: Authorizes park-and-ride development as construction or improvement by the department of transportation partly at municipal expense.

sponsored.t: Relates to the registration information required to be reported by a sex offender
sponsored.sum: Adds social security number, past home addresses, social media accounts, and online gamer information to the information required to be reported by a sex offender.

sponsored.t: Relates to franchise tax on banking corporations
sponsored.sum: Reinstates a bank tax based on the highest of four bases: a tax on allocated entire net income, a tax on allocated alternative entire net income, a tax on allocated taxable assets, or a fixed dollar minimum tax; prohibits banks from segregating their income and capital into business and investment varieties.

sponsored.t: Extends wage parity for home care workers in upstate New York
sponsored.sum: Extends wage parity for home care workers in upstate New York.

sponsored.t: Includes broadband access in the scoring and ranking criteria of the New York State low-income housing tax credit program
sponsored.sum: Includes broadband access in the scoring and ranking criteria of the New York State low-income housing tax credit program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the reporting of animal cruelty
sponsored.sum: Provides that any person charged with enforcing laws prohibiting cruelty to animals shall cause a report to be made when, in the performance of their duties, such person has reasonable cause to believe that abuse or maltreatment of a child has also occurred; provides that a person charged with the responsibility of filing a report of child abuse or maltreatment shall also file a report of suspected animal cruelty.

sponsored.t: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact
sponsored.sum: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact; provides a streamlined pathway for medical professionals who are licensed in multiple states to obtain medical licensure in New York.

sponsored.t: Caps certain public utility profit margins at four percent
sponsored.sum: Caps public gas corporations, public electric corporations and municipal gas and electric companies at a profit margin of four percent per year.

sponsored.t: Relates to hospital compliance with federal hospital price transparency law, rules and regulations
sponsored.sum: Requires quarterly reporting on hospital compliance with federal hospital price transparency law, rules and regulations; establishes a civil penalty for non-compliance.

sponsored.t: Requires property/casualty insurance policies to state the types and causes of damage that are covered by such policy
sponsored.sum: Requires property/casualty insurance policies to state the types and causes of damage that are covered by such policy; requires such information to be provided at or near the beginning of such policy.

sponsored.t: Provides the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly the ability to appoint members of the state university of New York's board of trustees
sponsored.sum: Provides the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly the ability to appoint four members each of the state university of New York's board of trustees; reduces the members of such board the governor appoints to seven.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing penalties for assault, obstruction and harassment of an election officer
sponsored.sum: Includes within the class D felony of assault in the second degree, the intentional causing of physical injury to an election officer while such person is performing their assigned duties; amends aggravated harassment and obstruction of governmental administration to include election officers.

sponsored.t: Requires utility corporations and municipalities include in an email regarding a bill for service the amount owed on such bill for service
sponsored.sum: Requires utility corporations and municipalities include in an email regarding a bill for service the amount owed on such bill for service where the amount owed is prominently displayed and accurate.

sponsored.t: Relates to the criminal impersonation in the second degree and establishing a stolen valor fee
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person is guilty of criminal impersonation in the second degree when a person pretends to be a servicemember or former servicemember, or a first responder, or as having received a decoration or medal; establishes a stolen valor fee.

sponsored.t: Provides for a formal process for a parent or legal guardian to request the issuance of an AMBER alert
sponsored.sum: Provides for a formal process for a parent or legal guardian to request the issuance of an AMBER alert.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting exemptions from immunizations; repealer
sponsored.sum: Limits exemptions from immunization requirements by local governments and private entities to medical exemptions; repeals religious exemptions for certain post-secondary students.

sponsored.t: Permits special education services and programs for preschool children with handicapping conditions to establish reserve funds
sponsored.sum: Permits special education services and programs for preschool children with handicapping conditions to establish reserve funds.

sponsored.t: Requires utility companies to report on utility poles and remove unused utility poles in the public right-of-way
sponsored.sum: Requires utility companies to report on utility poles and remove unused utility poles in the public right-of-way.

sponsored.t: Relates to certification by pharmacists of patients using medical cannabis
sponsored.sum: Relates to the content and procedure for certification by pharmacists of patients using medical cannabis; allows a pharmacist employed by a registered organization and responsible for supervising the dispensing of medical cannabis within a cannabis dispensing facility to recommend and certify patients upon consultation within such dispensing facility.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing hospital-sponsored off campus emergency departments
sponsored.sum: Establishes hospital-sponsored off campus emergency departments as a "hospital"; sets out specific standards for operations, staffing and capacity requirements.

sponsored.t: Includes certain charges of criminal possession of a weapon in the third degree as a qualifying offense for consideration of an order of recognizance, release under non-monetary conditions or bail
sponsored.sum: Includes certain charges of criminal possession of a weapon in the third degree as a qualifying offense for consideration of an order of recognizance, release under non-monetary conditions or bail.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the importing, possession, or sale of any part or product of the skin or body of a kangaroo for commercial purposes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the importing, possession, or sale of any part or product of the skin or body of a kangaroo for commercial purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to prior authorization and payments from the medical indemnity fund
sponsored.sum: Requires any regulation that mandates prior authorization to establish a mechanism for submission of requests for prior authorization by health care providers directly to the medical indemnity fund; requires the medical indemnity fund administrator to notify qualified plaintiffs which costs are qualifying health care costs to be paid from the fund and which are not within a reasonably prompt period of time.

sponsored.t: Relates to coroner qualifications
sponsored.sum: Requires any elected or appointed coroner who is not a licensed physician to be a certified nurse practitioner or licensed physician assistant authorized to practice medicine in this state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance of appearance tickets for certain violations of the agriculture and markets law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issuance of appearance tickets for certain violations of the agriculture and markets law when the person is charged with a crime for which the court may order the posting of a security.

sponsored.t: Requires certain joint tax returns pertaining to residential real estate cash purchases by limited liability companies to disclose the source of funds used for the purchase
sponsored.sum: Requires certain joint tax returns pertaining to residential real estate cash purchases by limited liability companies to be accompanied by a document which identifies the source or sources of funds used for the purchase, including the type of funding used, the bank account information of any funds used in the purchase and the amount used by each source of funds.

sponsored.t: Relates to the enforcement of taxes in certain school districts
sponsored.sum: Relates to the enforcement of taxes in certain school districts.

sponsored.t: Exempts private investigators from restrictions on possessing a weapon in sensitive and restrictive locations
sponsored.sum: Exempts private investigators from restrictions on possessing a weapon in sensitive and restrictive locations while traveling to and from and during the course of their employment and at any necessary and appropriate location during work hours; clarifies that a security guard may possess a weapon going to and from work.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursements practices of pharmacy benefit managers
sponsored.sum: Ensures reimbursement practices of pharmacy benefit managers do not allow for reimbursement of an amount less than the cost of procuring the drugs.

sponsored.t: Establishes registered medical assistants
sponsored.sum: Establishes registered medical assistants; outlines what such persons can do with such title.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of primates in entertainment acts
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of primates in entertainment acts; prohibits the department of environmental conservation for issuing any license or permit that would authorize the use of a primate in an entertainment act.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the health emergency response data system
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the health emergency response data system, which collects information and statistical data relating to public health emergencies in order to assist the department of health, other government entities, health care providers, and the public in understanding and responding to public health emergencies.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of financial services publish a report on long-term care insurance rates
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of financial services publish a report on long-term care insurance rates including historical rates and the dates and amounts of any rate changes.

sponsored.t: Requires the immunization of certain post-secondary students against hepatitis B
sponsored.sum: Requires the immunization of certain post-secondary students against hepatitis B.

sponsored.t: Relates to observing daylight savings time permanently; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to New York observing daylight savings time permanently.

sponsored.t: Requires disclosure of annual employment reports for certain non-charitable, non-profit entities
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure to the department of audit and control of annual employment reports for non-charitable, non-profit entities that are qualified as an exempt organization or entity by the United States Treasury under I.R.C. 501(c)(3) and (4) and that receives more than twenty-five percent of their total annual revenue from state funds.

sponsored.t: Increases the income thresholds for eligibility for the senior citizen and disabled person property tax exemptions
sponsored.sum: Increases the income thresholds for eligibility for the senior citizen and disabled person property tax exemptions; applies to any local law, resolution or ordinance amended or adopted on and after the effective date of this act.

sponsored.t: Relates to adopting the Appalachian states radioactive waste compact
sponsored.sum: Relates to adopting the Appalachian states radioactive waste compact; assures interstate cooperation for the proper management and disposal of low-level radioactive wastes to reduce the volume of low-level radioactive waste.

sponsored.t: Relates to standard utility interconnection of sub-transmission lines for particular projects
sponsored.sum: Permits the standard utility interconnection of sub-transmission lines for particular projects.

sponsored.t: Relates to tax billing addresses
sponsored.sum: Provides that local assessor offices no longer must add a code to notification forms for creation of termination of a mortgage escrow account.

sponsored.t: Increases the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit
sponsored.sum: Increases the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit.

sponsored.t: Requires domestic violence and sexual assault awareness training for the licensing of nail specialty, natural hair styling, esthetics and cosmetology
sponsored.sum: Requires domestic violence and sexual assault awareness training for the licensing of nail specialty, natural hair styling, esthetics and cosmetology.

sponsored.t: Relates to professional obligations under the physician loan repayment program
sponsored.sum: Relates to professional obligations under the physician loan repayment program; provides an option to practice as a physician engaged in private practice in an underserved area.

sponsored.t: Relates to tax exemptions for properties in violation of zoning laws
sponsored.sum: Prohibits tax exemptions for properties in violation of zoning laws.

sponsored.t: Requires insurers to provide information on resources for insureds or enrollees recently diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers to provide information on resources for insureds or enrollees recently diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.

sponsored.t: Prevents relicensing of drivers who have been twice convicted of certain violations relating to driving
sponsored.sum: Prevents relicensing of drivers who have been twice convicted of certain violations relating to driving where physical injury occurs.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing vehicles with permits for handicapped parking issued anywhere in the state to use all spaces for handicapped parking in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Provides that vehicles with permits for handicapped parking issued anywhere in the state may use all spaces for handicapped parking in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Enacts the integrity in government act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the integrity in government act; expands the powers and duties of the committee on open government.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of income in relation to the enhanced STAR exemption
sponsored.sum: Includes distribution from a thrift savings plan in the definition of income in relation to the enhanced STAR exemption.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal possession of a flamethrower
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of criminal possession of a flamethrower as a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program for rural health zones
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program for establishing and operating certain rural health zones.

sponsored.t: Establishes a supplemental burial allowance for certain first responders
sponsored.sum: Establishes a supplemental burial allowance for certain first responders.

sponsored.t: Requires the governor to prepare an annual management report of the state
sponsored.sum: Requires the governor to prepare an annual preliminary management report of the state and a final management report of the state which includes an assessment of performance goals and measures and other information pertaining to the actions of state agencies.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain training stipends for volunteer firefighters from state income tax
sponsored.sum: Excludes certain training stipends for volunteer firefighters from state income tax.

sponsored.t: Establishes a space exploration task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes a space exploration task force to study the potential for economic opportunities, ensuring the future survival of humanity and developing strategic advantages for this state by means of evolving space technology.

sponsored.t: Establishes certain persons who have previously provided a DNA sample shall not be required to pay a DNA databank fee for a conviction for certain offenses
sponsored.sum: Establishes that no person who has previously provided a DNA sample shall be required to pay a DNA databank fee for their conviction for a subsequent designated offense unless such sample has been expunged.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting wildlife and maintaining safety
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting wildlife and maintaining safety; necessitates written notification before a nuisance wildlife control operator undertakes any control measures.

sponsored.t: Prohibits fractional pricing of certain petroleum products
sponsored.sum: Prohibits fractional pricing of any motor fuel for use in internal combustion engines in motor vehicles or motorboats; imposes civil penalties of up to twenty-five dollars per day.

sponsored.t: Exempts farmers from commercial driver's license (CDL) requirements when operating a covered farm vehicle
sponsored.sum: Exempts farmers from commercial driver's license (CDL) requirements when operating a covered farm vehicle within one hundred fifty miles of such farmer's farm.

sponsored.t: Relates to reducing pharmacy benefit manager costs
sponsored.sum: Relates to reducing pharmacy benefit manager costs; defines "pharmacy benefit manager".

sponsored.t: Requires electronic filing of all financial disclosure statements
sponsored.sum: Requires electronic filing of all financial disclosure statements with the commission on ethics and lobbying in government.
sponsored.fis: The enactment of this bill will reduce administrative costs for the state.

sponsored.t: Provides for state aid for certain cities, towns, villages or fire districts adversely affected by a concentration of tax exempt property
sponsored.sum: Provides for state aid for certain cities, towns, villages or fire districts adversely affected by a concentration of tax exempt property.

sponsored.t: Relates to prescription drugs in Medicaid managed care programs; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires Medicaid managed care, and Child Health Plus plans to adopt the procedural protections of the Preferred Drug Program, including "prescriber prevails", for all drugs.

sponsored.t: Requires approval of the salary plan for the chancellors, presidents and senior staffs of the state university of New York and the city university of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires approval of the salary plan for the chancellors, presidents and senior staffs of the state university of New York and the city university of New York by the chairs of the senate finance committee and the assembly ways and means committee and the director of the budget.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crimes of reckless endangerment of an emergency service person in the first and second degrees
sponsored.sum: Establishes the offenses of reckless endangerment of an emergency service person in the first and second degrees.

sponsored.t: Ensures paid employees of the New York state division of military and naval affairs which perform fire response or fire rescue duties are eligible for equal benefits as other paid firefighters
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the definition of a paid firefighter to include firefighters employed by the division of military and naval affairs for the purpose of receiving certain benefits as other firefighters.

sponsored.t: Relates to anti-concurrent causation clauses
sponsored.sum: Provides that when a flood event not covered under a policy or specifically excluded is a contributing factor in or occurs simultaneously as a covered event or peril, the insurer shall not deny or exclude coverage for the loss or damage caused by the covered event or peril.

sponsored.t: Establishes the gallon as the standard measurement for purposes of taxation of alcoholic beverages
sponsored.sum: Establishes the gallon as the standard measurement for purposes of taxation of alcoholic beverages.

sponsored.t: Requires labor peace agreements in contracts for certain retail or distribution projects involving public agencies
sponsored.sum: Requires labor peace agreements as a precondition for contracts for certain retail or distribution projects in which a public agency has a substantial proprietary interest.

sponsored.t: Requires village elections on the same date as general elections take place on even numbered years
sponsored.sum: Requires village elections occurring on the same date as the general election take place on even numbered years.

sponsored.t: Makes chapter 689 of the laws of 1993 permanent
sponsored.sum: Makes chapter 689 of the laws of 1993, and thus article 182 of the criminal procedure law titled alternate method of court appearance, permanent.

sponsored.t: Increases the capacity needed to be considered a bottle club
sponsored.sum: Increases the capacity needed to be considered a bottle club from twenty persons to one hundred persons.

sponsored.t: Requires a period of unstructured physical play for pupils enrolled in kindergarten and grades one through five
sponsored.sum: Requires a period of unstructured physical play for pupils enrolled in kindergarten and grades one through five.

sponsored.t: Permits electronic arraignment in counties not wholly included within a city; repealer
sponsored.sum: Permits electronic arraignment in counties not wholly included within a city.

sponsored.t: Subjects certain state lands to real property taxation
sponsored.sum: Subjects certain state lands to real property taxation within Orange county.

sponsored.t: Prohibits off-track betting corporation vehicles from being used as take-home vehicles
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits off-track betting corporation vehicles from being used as take-home vehicles by board members, officers, employees, contractors, subcontractors, consultants, or agents of such corporation or by certain family members of such individuals; provides an exception therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for ambulance services
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement for ambulance services; requires insurers to submit payments directly to ambulance providers who are in-network or, for out-of-network ambulance providers, requires the issuance of a joint check to the insured specifying both the insured and the ambulance provider as payees.

sponsored.t: Relates to contract cost adjustments in the middle of contract terms for school districts transportation contracts
sponsored.sum: Provides that contract cost adjustments in the middle of contract terms for school districts transportation contracts shall be at no additional cost to the state, locality or school district unless such amendment is necessary to comply with the statewide transition to zero-emission buses and provided that it has been established by the contractor that there has been at least an equivalent increase in the amount of such contractor's cost of operation.

sponsored.t: Prohibits regional off-track betting corporations from providing items of value exceeding fifteen dollars to certain associates of the corporation
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits regional off-track betting corporations from providing items of value exceeding fifteen dollars to any board member, officer, or employee of the corporation, any contractor, subcontractor, consultant, or other agent of the corporation, or any spouse, child, sibling or parent of such persons; adds reporting requirements for regional off-track betting corporations.

sponsored.t: Enacts Killian's law
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Killian's law"; establishes a timely repair for wheelchair program; extends the warranty period for wheelchairs to 2 years; deems all wheelchair repairs needed within 5 years of initial prescription medically necessary.

sponsored.t: Creates licenses for roadside farm markets to sell beer, cider, and liquor
sponsored.sum: Creates licenses for roadside farm markets to sell beer, cider, and liquor.
sponsored.fis: Increased state revenue through sales tax and annual fee collections.

sponsored.t: Relates to farm worker meal and lodging minimum wage credits
sponsored.sum: Relates to farm worker meal, lodging and utilities minimum wage credits being adjusted for cost of living increases.

sponsored.t: Establishes a correctional employee protective labor practices board
sponsored.sum: Establishes a correctional employee protective labor practices board to make recommendations regarding labor practices and working conditions for correctional employees, and institutional safety of both correctional employees and incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Prohibits data brokers from selling the personal information of current and former military servicemembers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits data brokers from selling the personal information of current and former military servicemembers or their households without consent.

sponsored.t: Requires bus drivers complete a human trafficking recognition training program
sponsored.sum: Requires bus drivers complete a human trafficking recognition training program which includes the nature of human trafficking; how human trafficking is defined in law; how to identify someone who is human trafficking; how to identify someone who is a human trafficking victim; and entities to whom a driver may report suspected activity that might constitute human trafficking.

sponsored.t: Relates to the execution of certificates by persons conducting business under assumed names or as partners
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that each certificate be duly acknowledged by the person or persons conducting business.

sponsored.t: Includes the display of a swastika in public view in aggravated harassment in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Relates to aggravated harassment in the first degree; includes the display of a swastika in public view in aggravated harassment in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Requires health districts be accredited to receive funding from the department of health
sponsored.sum: Requires health districts be accredited to receive funding from the department of health.

sponsored.t: Subjects individuals who are accessories to illegal activities relating to public officers to the same penalties as those who perform such activities
sponsored.sum: Subjects an individual who solicits, requests, commands, importunes, or intentionally aids or assists in illegal activities under the public officers law, the civil service law, or the legislative law relating to public officers to the same penalties as those who violate such provisions of law.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of body imaging scanning equipment in local correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of body imaging scanning equipment in local correctional facilities for the screening of visitors in addition to incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Requires immunization against rotavirus for certain children
sponsored.sum: Requires immunization against age appropriate rotavirus for certain children attending school.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the New York state federal relations office; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the New York state federal relations office in Washington, DC; makes an appropriation therefor.
sponsored.fis: Appropriates $300,000 from the state treasury to cover the initial costs of establishing and operating the office. Expected to generate substan- tial returns through increased federal funding and grants.

sponsored.t: Establishes and determines the composition of the committee on gubernatorial inability
sponsored.sum: Establishes and determines the composition of the committee on gubernatorial inability.

sponsored.t: Relates to the line of succession for the office of governor; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the line of succession for the office of governor when the governor is impeached or unable to perform such governor's duties.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for anesthesia services
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement for anesthesia services; provides that an insurer may use a time related reimbursement methodology for anesthesia services if such methodology is based upon criteria established by an independent organization.

sponsored.t: Permits the detention of juveniles with adults in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Permits the detention of juveniles with adults when no other facility is available within fifty miles.

sponsored.t: Restricts who may sign certain checks issued by the state and what signatures and images can be on such checks
sponsored.sum: Restricts who may sign checks issued by the state associated with the inflation refund credit to the commissioner of taxation and finance or their designee; prohibits such checks from containing the name, likeness, image, facsimile signature, or actual signature of the governor.

sponsored.t: Requires principals convicted of certain animal cruelty offenses undergo a presentencing forensic psychological evaluation and a report be submitted to the court based on such evaluation and to attend treatment
sponsored.sum: Requires principals convicted of certain animal cruelty offenses undergo a presentencing forensic psychological evaluation and a report be submitted to the court based on such evaluation and to attend counseling, humane education, a rehabilitation program, or other such treatment based on such report.

sponsored.t: Authorizes courts, upon issuance of an order of protection, to order exclusive care, custody, and control of certain companion animals be granted to the petitioner
sponsored.sum: Authorizes courts, upon issuance of an order of protection, to order exclusive care, custody, and control of certain companion animals be granted to the petitioner

sponsored.t: Prohibits the possession of an open container of cannabis or cannabis product in the passenger area of certain motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the possession of an open container of cannabis or cannabis product in the passenger area of certain motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to compensation of members of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Provides that in years where a pay period occurs on January first of such year, the salaries of members of the legislature shall be payable in twenty-seven bi-weekly payments.

sponsored.t: Relates to joining multistate voter list maintenance organizations

sponsored.fis: A one-time membership fee of $25,000 is required to join ERIC to help cover expenses for technology upgrades and expansions necessary to support a growing membership. States also pay annual dues to cover operating costs and are based, in part, on the citizen voting age population in each state. Members approve the dues and the annual budget. Dues for the 2022-23 fiscal year range from about $26,000 to about $116,000. ERIC's 2021-22 operating budget is about $1,538,000. ERIC conducts annual independent audits of its financial statements.

sponsored.t: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold
sponsored.sum: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold; provides that any manufacturer, dealer, or agent of a manufacturer or dealer that fails to comply with such requirements shall be assessed a civil penalty not to exceed two hundred fifty dollars per point of sale for each violation.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 91 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 5708, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to prohibit- ing motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold" NOT APPROVED This bill restricts vehicle manufacturers from offering or selling subscription services of motor vehicle features installed in the car at the time of purchase. I believe in strong consumer protections; however, this bill limits consumer choices and may increase the costs of new vehicles. Addi- tionally, the bill does not specify which agency is provided with rule- making authority to regulate a complex market. Therefore, I am constrained to veto this bill. The bill is disapproved. (signed) KATHY HOCHUL __________
